messages:
rachel.design: Shared a pared-down IA sketch: group entries by user task (Develop / Serve / Observe). Trying to make deep links more discoverable. figma: https://figma.redwood/console/ia-slim
tom.pm: Looks cleaner. Question: will customers' existing bookmarks break if we move "Insights" under Observe?
arun.frontend: we should keep canonical paths stable and accept aliases. Plan: server middleware maps legacy segments -> canonical route, emit redirect telemetry. display a small migration banner when redirect happens.
leah.a11y: Accessibility note: when groups collapse or reorder, keyboard focus can land off-screen. Suggest setting focus to the nearest visible item and announce via aria-live: "Navigation updated, focus moved to <item>". Also ensure group headers use aria-expanded.
rachel.design: Agreed on focus behavior. For breadcrumbs, prefer resource-hierarchy (Org / Workspace / Page). For verbs, use action chips to the right (Edit / View logs) instead of mixing into the trail.
tom.pm: Path contract proposal: /console/:org/:space/:section/:resourceId with optional query params for UI state (?panel=metrics). Avoid using hash fragments for important state.
arun.frontend: Implementation bits: add data-legacy-route attributes on nav items for mapping, canonicalize middleware returns 302 during experiment then 301 post-deprecation, and log redirect.source + redirect.count. Dev ETA: ~2.5 days.
leah.a11y: Small copy nit: breadcrumb separator use U+203A (single guillemet) visually, but aria-hidden it so SRs skip it. Provide aria-label on the nav landmark.
infra-bot: Created RED-6092: "Slim IA: aliases + breadcrumb contract + a11y checklist" assigned to arun.frontend; due 2026-01-12. :white_check_mark:
